name: Alekain Foundation's Claim Your Diploma Initiative
description: The Alekain Foundation's Claim Your Diploma Initiative is a fully funded online education program that enables Afghan girls aged 16 and above who are living in Afghanistan to earn an accredited U.S. high school diploma through Smart Schools International. Designed for students who have completed middle school, the program offers flexible, self-paced coursework that can be completed within 16 to 24 months. In addition to academic instruction, participants receive mentorship, academic assistance, mental wellness support, and essential technology to help them succeed. Graduates earn an internationally recognized diploma that expands their opportunities for higher education and future careers. Applicants must demonstrate English proficiency (minimum B2 CEFR), leadership potential, and a strong commitment to continuing their education. The application deadline for the 2026–2027 cohort is August 30, 2026.
